reference_description: The pie chart represents a categorization of different types of characters into three main groups: "Virtual Characters"(blue), "Custom Characters"(red), and "Real Characters"(green). These three groups form the inner circle of the chart and are further divided into subgroups in the outer slice of each group. The central blue segment, labeled "Virtual Characters," occupies about 3/4th of the chart and further divides into segments in the outer circle like "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," each shaded in light blue. "Custom Characters" is shown in a red slice, occupying a smaller portion adjacent to the "Virtual Characters", but doesn't have any labeled sub groups in outer circle. "Real Characters" is depicted in green, with further subdivisions such as "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers" all in shades of light green. The chart doesn't include a legend and percentage labels inside the slices to provide exact proportions. There is no visual emphasis such as exploding or offsetting of any slice. The segments within each main category appear to be presented in the same order, without any specific visual ordering based on size.
